visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a white light jacket over a beige graphic t-shirt and gold necklaces, walks on an outdoor street while filming herself in a selfie style. In the background, a blue vending machine and a yellow trash bin are visible against a grey tiled pavement. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a green and yellow snack package for Seven-Eleven Sugar Butter Sand Tree, pistachio flavored. The hand holds the package in front of a supermarket shelf where several labels read 'Sold Out' and empty spaces are seen. (3) The woman jumps and dances excitedly in front of a large corporate building featuring the 'Seven & i Holdings' logo. A large colorful graphic '買到了!!' (I got it!!) appears on the screen. (4) Indoors, the woman is sitting on the floor in a living room, pulling several green snack packs out of a brown paper bag. She is now wearing a white ruffled off-the-shoulder blouse. (5) She holds one pack toward the camera, pointing at the pistachio illustration. She then opens the foil packaging, revealing a square, light-yellow biscuit with the words 'SUGAR BUTTER TREE' clearly printed on it. (6) Close-up of the woman taking a bite of the biscuit. Animated flowers and hearts pop up around her head as she eats. She shows the cross-section of the biscuit to the camera, revealing a thick layer of green pistachio cream inside. (7) She continues to talk to the camera while holding the remaining half of the biscuit, emphasizing the texture and the cream filling.
